    }                                                                                     // 97  endif
    o0.xyz = r0.xxx * r1.xyz;                                                             // 98  mul o0.xyz, r0.xxxx, r1.xyzx

    return;                                                                               // 100  ret

    b0.y = (AlphaTestRef.y < 1.0);                                                        // 117  lt r0.y, cb2[14].y, l(1.000000)
    if (b0.y) {                                                                           // 118  if_nz r0.y
        r0.y = -r2.x + AlphaTestRef.y;                                                    // 119  add r0.y, -r2.x, cb2[14].y
        b0.y = (r0.y < 0.0);                                                              // 120  lt r0.y, r0.y, l(0.000000)
        kill = kill || b0.y;                                                              // 121  discard_nz r0.y
    }                                                                                     // 122  endif
    o0.w = r0.x;                                                                          // 123  mov o0.w, r0.x
    return;                                                                               // 124  ret
}

    r6.xyzw = vec4(d3d_exp2(r6.x), d3d_exp2(r6.y), d3d_exp2(r6.z), d3d_exp2(r6.w));       // 66  exp r6.xyzw, r6.xyzw

    r0.y = r0.x * PropertyColor.w;                                                        // 96  mul r0.y, r0.x, cb2[13].w
    r0.z = -efx_COLOR1.w + 1.0;                                                           // 97  add r0.z, -v2.w, l(1.000000)

    r0.x = r0.x * PropertyColor.w + -AlphaTestRef.x;                                      // 99  mad r0.x, r0.x, cb2[13].w, -cb2[14].x
    b0.x = (r0.x < 0.0);                                                                  // 100  lt r0.x, r0.x, l(0.000000)
    kill = kill || b0.x;                                                                  // 101  discard_nz r0.x
    b0.x = (AlphaTestRef.y < 1.0);                                                        // 102  lt r0.x, cb2[14].y, l(1.000000)
    if (b0.x) {                                                                           // 103  if_nz r0.x
        r0.x = -r0.w + AlphaTestRef.y;                                                    // 104  add r0.x, -r0.w, cb2[14].y
        b0.x = (r0.x < 0.0);                                                              // 105  lt r0.x, r0.x, l(0.000000)
        kill = kill || b0.x;                                                              // 106  discard_nz r0.x
    }                                                                                     // 107  endif
    o0.w = r0.y;                                                                          // 108  mov o0.w, r0.y
    return;                                                                               // 109  ret
}

        kill = kill || b0.y;                                                              // 120  discard_nz r0.y
    }                                                                                     // 121  endif

        b0.x = (r0.x < 0.0);                                                              // 127  lt r0.x, r0.x, l(0.000000)

        b0.x = (r0.x < 0.0);                                                              // 144  lt r0.x, r0.x, l(0.000000)
        kill = kill || b0.x;                                                              // 145  discard_nz r0.x
    }                                                                                     // 146  endif

}

                                                                                          // 195  mad o6.xyz, r0.yyyy, r1.xyzx, r0.xzwx   [no consumer: omitted]

}

}

    r3.y = dot(cb12_viewproj[1].xyzw, r6.xyzw);                                           // 95  dp4 r3.y, cb12[9].xyzw, r6.xyzw
    r3.z = dot(cb12_viewproj[2].xyzw, r6.xyzw);                                           // 96  dp4 r3.z, cb12[10].xyzw, r6.xyzw
    r3.w = dot(cb12_viewproj[3].xyzw, r6.xyzw);                                           // 97  dp4 r3.w, cb12[11].xyzw, r6.xyzw
    o0.xyzw = r3.xyzw;                                                                    // 98  mov o0.xyzw, r3.xyzw
                                                                                          // 99  mad r4.xyz, v2.xyzx, l(2.000000, 2.000000, 2.000000, 0.000000), l(-1.000000, -1.000000, -1.000000, 0.000000)   [no consumer: omitted]
    r5.y = cpu_r0.y;                                                                      // 100  dp3 r5.y, r4.xyzx, r0.xyzx   [CPU route: mov r5.y, vcpun.y]
    r5.z = cpu_r0.z;                                                                      // 101  dp3 r5.z, r4.xyzx, r1.xyzx   [CPU route: mov r5.z, vcpun.z]
    r5.x = cpu_r0.x;                                                                      // 102  dp3 r5.x, r4.xyzx, r2.xyzx   [CPU route: mov r5.x, vcpun.x]
    r0.w = dot(r5.xyz, r5.xyz);                                                           // 103  dp3 r0.w, r5.xyzx, r5.xyzx
    r0.w = d3d_rsq(r0.w);                                                                 // 104  rsq r0.w, r0.w
    r4.xyz = r0.www * r5.xyz;                                                             // 105  mul r4.xyz, r0.wwww, r5.xyzx
    r0.w = dot(-r6.xyz, -r6.xyz);                                                         // 106  dp3 r0.w, -r6.xyzx, -r6.xyzx

    r5.xyz = r0.www * -r6.xyz;                                                            // 108  mul r5.xyz, r0.wwww, -r6.xyzx
    o7.xyz = r6.xyz;                                                                      // 109  mov o7.xyz, r6.xyzx
    r0.w = dot(r4.xyz, r5.xyz);                                                           // 110  dp3 r0.w, r4.xyzx, r5.xyzx
    o2.xyz = r5.xyz;                                                                      // 111  mov o2.xyz, r5.xyzx
    r0.w = abs(r0.w) + -FalloffData.x;                                                    // 112  add r0.w, |r0.w|, -cb1[2].x
    r5.xy = -FalloffData.xz + FalloffData.yw;                                             // 113  add r5.xy, -cb1[2].xzxx, cb1[2].ywyy
    r0.w = d3d_sat(d3d_div(r0.w, r5.x));                                                  // 114  div_sat r0.w, r0.w, r5.x
    r1.w = r0.w * r0.w;                                                                   // 115  mul r1.w, r0.w, r0.w
    r0.w = -r0.w * 2.0 + 3.0;                                                             // 116  mad r0.w, -r0.w, l(2.000000), l(3.000000)
    r0.w = r0.w * r1.w;                                                                   // 117  mul r0.w, r0.w, r1.w
    o1.z = r0.w * r5.y + FalloffData.z;                                                   // 118  mad o1.z, r0.w, r5.y, cb1[2].z
    o1.xy = vs_TEXCOORD0.xy * TexcoordOffset.zw + TexcoordOffset.xy;                      // 119  mad o1.xy, v1.xyxx, cb1[0].zwzz, cb1[0].xyxx
                                                                                          // 120  mov o1.w, v1.y   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 121  mov o2.w, l(0)   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 122  mov r5.x, v0.w   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 123  mad r5.y, v2.w, l(2.000000), l(-1.000000)   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 124  mad r5.z, v3.w, l(2.000000), l(-1.000000)   [no consumer: omitted]
    r6.y = cpu_r2.y;                                                                      // 125  dp3 r6.y, r5.xyzx, r0.xyzx   [CPU route: mov r6.y, vcpux.y]
    r6.z = cpu_r2.z;                                                                      // 126  dp3 r6.z, r5.xyzx, r1.xyzx   [CPU route: mov r6.z, vcpux.z]
    r6.x = cpu_r2.x;                                                                      // 127  dp3 r6.x, r5.xyzx, r2.xyzx   [CPU route: mov r6.x, vcpux.x]
    r0.w = dot(r6.xyz, r6.xyz);                                                           // 128  dp3 r0.w, r6.xyzx, r6.xyzx
    r0.w = d3d_rsq(r0.w);                                                                 // 129  rsq r0.w, r0.w
    r5.xyz = r0.www * r6.xyz;                                                             // 130  mul r5.xyz, r0.wwww, r6.xyzx
    o3.x = dot(r5.xyz, World[0].xyz);                                                     // 131  dp3 o3.x, r5.xyzx, cb2[4].xyzx
    o3.y = dot(r5.xyz, World[1].xyz);                                                     // 132  dp3 o3.y, r5.xyzx, cb2[5].xyzx
    o3.z = dot(r5.xyz, World[2].xyz);                                                     // 133  dp3 o3.z, r5.xyzx, cb2[6].xyzx
                                                                                          // 134  mad r5.xyz, v3.xyzx, l(2.000000, 2.000000, 2.000000, 0.000000), l(-1.000000, -1.000000, -1.000000, 0.000000)   [no consumer: omitted]
    r0.y = cpu_r1.y;                                                                      // 135  dp3 r0.y, r5.xyzx, r0.xyzx   [CPU route: mov r0.y, vcpub.y]
    r0.z = cpu_r1.z;                                                                      // 136  dp3 r0.z, r5.xyzx, r1.xyzx   [CPU route: mov r0.z, vcpub.z]
    r0.x = cpu_r1.x;                                                                      // 137  dp3 r0.x, r5.xyzx, r2.xyzx   [CPU route: mov r0.x, vcpub.x]
    r0.w = dot(r0.xyz, r0.xyz);                                                           // 138  dp3 r0.w, r0.xyzx, r0.xyzx
    r0.w = d3d_rsq(r0.w);                                                                 // 139  rsq r0.w, r0.w
    r0.xyz = r0.www * r0.xyz;                                                             // 140  mul r0.xyz, r0.wwww, r0.xyzx
    o4.x = dot(r0.xyz, World[0].xyz);                                                     // 141  dp3 o4.x, r0.xyzx, cb2[4].xyzx
    o4.y = dot(r0.xyz, World[1].xyz);                                                     // 142  dp3 o4.y, r0.xyzx, cb2[5].xyzx
    o4.z = dot(r0.xyz, World[2].xyz);                                                     // 143  dp3 o4.z, r0.xyzx, cb2[6].xyzx
    o5.x = dot(r4.xyz, World[0].xyz);                                                     // 144  dp3 o5.x, r4.xyzx, cb2[4].xyzx
    o5.y = dot(r4.xyz, World[1].xyz);                                                     // 145  dp3 o5.y, r4.xyzx, cb2[5].xyzx
    o5.z = dot(r4.xyz, World[2].xyz);                                                     // 146  dp3 o5.z, r4.xyzx, cb2[6].xyzx
    r0.x = dot(cb12_invproj[0].xyzw, r3.xyzw);                                            // 147  dp4 r0.x, cb12[20].xyzw, r3.xyzw
    r0.y = dot(cb12_invproj[1].xyzw, r3.xyzw);                                            // 148  dp4 r0.y, cb12[21].xyzw, r3.xyzw
    r0.z = dot(cb12_invproj[2].xyzw, r3.xyzw);                                            // 149  dp4 r0.z, cb12[22].xyzw, r3.xyzw
    o8.z = d3d_div(r3.w, SoftMaterialVSParams.x);                                         // 150  div o8.z, r3.w, cb1[1].x
    r0.w = 1.0;                                                                           // 151  mov r0.w, l(1.000000)
    r0.w = dot(cb12_invview[2].xyzw, r0.xyzw);                                            // 152  dp4 r0.w, cb12[14].xyzw, r0.xyzw
    r0.x = dot(r0.xyz, r0.xyz);                                                           // 153  dp3 r0.x, r0.xyzx, r0.xyzx
    r0.x = d3d_sqrt(r0.x);                                                                // 154  sqrt r0.x, r0.x
    r0.x = r0.x * cb12_fog[0].x + -(cb12_fog[0].z);                                       // 155  mad r0.x, r0.x, cb12[41].x, -cb12[41].z
    r0.y = r0.w + cb12_35.z;                                                              // 156  add r0.y, r0.w, cb12[35].z
    r0.yz = vec2(d3d_sat(r0.y * cb12_fog[5].x + -cb12_fog[5].z), d3d_sat(r0.y * cb12_fog[5].y + -cb12_fog[5].w));// 157  mad_sat r0.yz, r0.yyyy, cb12[46].xxyx, -cb12[46].zzwz
    r0.z = -r0.y + r0.z;                                                                  // 158  add r0.z, -r0.y, r0.z
    r0.w = d3d_sat(r0.x);                                                                 // 159  mov_sat r0.w, r0.x
    r0.y = r0.w * r0.z + r0.y;                                                            // 160  mad r0.y, r0.w, r0.z, r0.y
    r0.z = -r0.y + 1.0;                                                                   // 161  add r0.z, -r0.y, l(1.000000)
    r0.z = r0.y * cb12_fog[3].w + r0.z;                                                   // 162  mad r0.z, r0.y, cb12[44].w, r0.z
    b1.x = (0.75 < r0.x);                                                                 // 163  lt r1.x, l(0.750000), r0.x
    b0.x = (r0.x < FO4_L_0_015);                                                          // 164  lt r0.x, r0.x, l(0.015000)
    r1.y = r0.w + -0.75;                                                                  // 165  add r1.y, r0.w, l(-0.750000)
    r1.y = r1.y * 4.0;                                                                    // 166  mul r1.y, r1.y, l(4.000000)
    r1.z = -(cb12_fog[2].w) + 1.0;                                                        // 167  add r1.z, -cb12[43].w, l(1.000000)
    r1.y = r1.y * r1.z + cb12_fog[2].w;                                                   // 168  mad r1.y, r1.y, r1.z, cb12[43].w
    r1.y = d3d_min(r1.y, 1.0);                                                            // 169  min r1.y, r1.y, l(1.000000)
    r1.x = b1.x ? r1.y : cb12_fog[2].w;                                                   // 170  movc r1.x, r1.x, r1.y, cb12[43].w
    r1.y = d3d_log2(r0.w);                                                                // 171  log r1.y, r0.w
    r0.w = r0.w * FO4_L_66_666672;                                                        // 172  mul r0.w, r0.w, l(66.666672)
    r0.x = b0.x ? r0.w : 1.0;                                                             // 173  movc r0.x, r0.x, r0.w, l(1.000000)
    r0.w = r1.y * cb12_fog[1].w;                                                          // 174  mul r0.w, r1.y, cb12[42].w
    r0.w = d3d_exp2(r0.w);                                                                // 175  exp r0.w, r0.w
    r0.w = d3d_min(r1.x, r0.w);                                                           // 176  min r0.w, r1.x, r0.w
    r0.z = r0.z * r0.w;                                                                   // 177  mul r0.z, r0.z, r0.w
    o6.w = r0.x * r0.z;                                                                   // 178  mul o6.w, r0.x, r0.z
                                                                                          // 179  add r1.xyz, -cb12[43].xyzx, cb12[45].xyzx   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 180  mad r1.xyz, r0.wwww, r1.xyzx, cb12[43].xyzx   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 181  add r2.xyz, -cb12[42].xyzx, cb12[44].xyzx   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 182  mad r0.xzw, r0.wwww, r2.xxyz, cb12[42].xxyz   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 183  add r1.xyz, -r0.xzwx, r1.xyzx   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 184  mad o6.xyz, r0.yyyy, r1.xyzx, r0.xzwx   [no consumer: omitted]
                                                                                          // 185  mov o8.xy, l(0,0,0,0)   [no consumer: omitted]
    return;                                                                               // 186  ret
}
